about-story-expertise.title: About Story Expertise
about-story-expertise.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to only generate 2 or 4 `expertiseAreas` since the expertiseAreas element uses a 2 column layout. Keep the highlight prop's label, title, and description succinct since too long of content will distort the layout.

about-story-gallery.title: About Story Gallery
about-story-gallery.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to use 3, 6, 9, etc `images` since the images showcase is a 3 column layout.

about-streamline-team.title: About Streamline Team
about-streamline-team.importantUsageNotes: Only use 1 `action` prop and don't exceed 4 `features` or it will distort the layout

about-vision-gallery.title: About Vision Gallery
about-vision-gallery.importantUsageNotes: Follow the example props closely for this block, especially the count of images.

about-culture-tabs.title: About Culture Tabs
about-culture-tabs.importantUsageNotes: This block has a large number of strict requirements and should only be used for a website that has a large number of imges, reviews/testimonials, etc. Only use if you generate exactly 4 `aspects` since any more/fewer will distort the layout. Follow the example props very closely for this block, e.g. image counts in each section, 1 REAL (DO NOT GENERATE FAKE REVIEWS/TESTIMONIALS) testimonial per aspect, etc.

about-expandable-values.title: About Expandable Values
about-expandable-values.importantUsageNotes: Follow the example props closely for this block.

about-mission-principles.title: About Mission Principles
about-mission-principles.importantUsageNotes: Only use this block if you have 4 `principles` props, any different count than 4 will distort the layout. Follow the example props closely for this block.

about-split-hero.title: About Split Hero
about-split-hero.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to use concise content for the text content props since too long of content will distort the layout.

community-initiatives.title: Community Initiatives
community-initiatives.importantUsageNotes: Only use if you generate 3-5 `categories` since any more/fewer will distort the layout.

article-breadcrumb-social.title: Article Breadcrumb Social
article-breadcrumb-social.importantUsageNotes: ONLY use a valid markdown string for the content, supplied to the `markdownString` prop. Ensure to adhere to the required markdown formatting to inject `id` attributes for each section that map exactly to the `sections` `id` value. Ensure to only use the author.ame, author.image, and author.role fields if you have actual data to populate those fields, using empty/fake data is not acceptable!

article-chapters-author.title: Article Chapters Author
article-chapters-author.importantUsageNotes: ONLY use a valid markdown string for the content, supplied to the `markdownString` prop. Ensure to adhere to the required markdown formatting to inject `id` attributes for each chapter that map exactly to the `chapters` `id` value. Ensure to only use the author.ame, author.image, author.bio, author.socialLinks, and author.role fields if you have actual data to populate those fields, using empty/fake data is not acceptable! Ensure to ONLY use valid `href` values for the `conclusionActions`

article-compact-toc.title: Article Compact TOC
article-compact-toc.importantUsageNotes: ONLY use a valid markdown string for the content, supplied to the `markdownString` prop. Ensure to adhere to the required markdown formatting to inject `id` attributes for each section that map exactly to the `sections` `id` value. Ensure to only use the authorName, authorImage, authorHref, and authorImage fields if you have actual data to populate those fields, using empty/fake data is not acceptable!

article-hero-prose.title: Article Hero Prose
article-hero-prose.importantUsageNotes: ONLY use a valid markdown string for the content, supplied to the `markdownString` prop. Ensure to only use the post.authorName, post.authorImage, post.authorHref, and post.authorImage fields if you have actual data to populate those fields, using empty/fake data is not acceptable!

article-sidebar-sticky.title: Article Sidebar Sticky
article-sidebar-sticky.importantUsageNotes: ONLY use a valid markdown string for the content, supplied to the `markdownString` prop. Ensure to only use the authorName, authorImage, authorHref, and authorImage fields if you have actual data to populate those fields, using empty/fake data is not acceptable!

article-toc-sidebar.title: Article TOC Sidebar
article-toc-sidebar.importantUsageNotes: ONLY use a valid markdown string for the content, supplied to the `markdownString` prop. Ensure to adhere to the required markdown formatting to inject `id` attributes for each section that map exactly to the `sections` `id` value. Ensure to only use the authorName, authorImage, authorHref, and authorImage fields if you have actual data to populate those fields, using empty/fake data is not acceptable! Only provide valid `ctaActions` and only provide a `ctaTitle` and `ctaDescription` if you have actual `ctaActions` (typically only 1 ctaAction looks best).

carousel-progress-slider.title: Carousel Progress Slider
carousel-progress-slider.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to generate succinct titles and descriptions for each of the 'slides' since too much content will distort the layout. Follow the example props closely for this block.

feature-integration-cards.title: Feature Integration Cards
feature-integration-cards.importantUsageNotes: Only use when block images will be logos or compact integration marks. The image slots are intentionally sized down for logos, so photos, screenshots, people, product imagery, and large illustrations will look poor.

feature-stats-highlight.title: Feature Stats Highlight
feature-stats-highlight.importantUsageNotes: Only use short, numerical style strings for each of the `value` elements in the `stats` props array, e.g. '99.99%', '< 100ms', '24/7' - character counts larger than those examples will distort the layout and using words for those slots are a poor UI choice since they're very clearly made for numerical/stat data (in string form).

faq-icon-benefits.title: FAQ Icon Benefits
faq-icon-benefits.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to generate exactly 3, 6, 9, or 12 `benefits` since the block uses a 3 column layout. Follow the example props closely for this block.

process-mission-principles.title: Process Mission Principles
process-mission-principles.importantUsageNotes: Ensure to generate exactly 3, 6, or 9 'principles' since the principles element is a 3 column layout. Follow the example props closely for this block.
